market_summary: Markets rose for a second day on Thu 26 Nov but gave up most early gains: the Nifty closed up 0.25% at 25,884.50 and the Sensex up 0.46% at 84,328.59, led by IT (+3.66%, HCL Tech +6.4%, TCS +4.9%, Infosys +4.7%) and realty (+3.3%), while FMCG (-0.9%), autos (-0.7%) and banks (Nifty Bank -0.3%) fell. FIIs bought a provisional ₹5,843 cr, their 18th straight buying session, and India VIX eased about 4.7% to 16.84; Brent stayed near $90-95 and the US has proposed tariffs of up to 25% on Indian goods (17% with a trade deal). Results season is over and no notable results are due today; Mahanadi Coalfields lists today and RBI policy is on 4 Dec.

buy_ideas.name: Apollo Hospitals
buy_ideas.target_source: Macquarie (double upgrade to Outperform from Underperform, target raised from ₹6,230), via INDmoney 20 Nov
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 23% to ₹7,615 cr, EBITDA 29% to ₹1,191 cr and profit 32% to ₹630 cr; margin widened to 15.6% from 14.9%. Inpatient volumes +14%, occupancy up to 73%, pharmacy (HealthCo) EBITDA +75%. Stock jumped 5.3% to an all-time high of about ₹9,200 on 20 Nov; Macquarie's ₹10,500 target is about 14% higher, and Motilal had ₹10,400.
buy_ideas.risks: Bought after a 5% one-day jump to a record high, so wait for a dip rather than chasing. Hospital stocks sold off earlier this month on fears of drug-price regulation (Supreme Court query on pharmacy markups); that risk has not gone away. Prices move daily (Nifty -1.75% on 23 Nov, +1.85% on 25 Nov, +0.25% on 26 Nov), so check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: BSE Ltd
buy_ideas.target_source: HDFC Securities (upgraded to Buy from Add, target raised from ₹4,180), 26 Nov; ICICI Securities Buy ₹4,210, Motilal Oswal Buy ₹4,000
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 net profit rose about 45% to ₹809 cr (H1 profit +53%, H1 revenue +49%). HDFC Securities upgraded on 26 Nov citing options market-share gains (premium share 33.5% and notional 48.7% in October vs 32% and 46.8% in Q2), October premium turnover up 53% month on month, and a lower settlement-fund requirement; it raised EPS estimates and values BSE at about 44x FY27 earnings. Stock rose 5.7% to ₹3,990.40, a four-month high; the ₹4,450 target is about 11.5% higher.
buy_ideas.risks: Bought after a 5.7% one-day jump, so wait for a dip rather than chasing. Upside to target is now only about 11%, and Motilal (₹4,000) and JPMorgan (₹3,960) targets are near the current price. Earnings depend on options volumes, which SEBI rules can cut quickly. The Q2 profit figures come from a broker blog, not the filing itself.

buy_ideas.name: Eicher Motors
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 20% and profit about 15%. Stock closed ₹8,056 (+4.6%) on 19 Nov as autos rallied 4.4% on cheaper copper and aluminium, which eases the margin worry. Emkay's ₹9,100 target is about 13% above the close.
buy_ideas.risks: EBITDA margin fell 80 bps to 23.7%, and the stock has already jumped in one day; Motilal Oswal is only Neutral at ₹7,420. Metal prices can bounce back. No fresh price found for 20 Nov; ₹8,056 is the 19 Nov close (autos rose about 0.5% on Friday). Prices move daily (Nifty -1.75% on 23 Nov, +1.85% on 25 Nov, +0.25% on 26 Nov), so check the live quote. Autos fell 0.7% on 26 Nov.

buy_ideas.name: Laurus Labs
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up about 33% to ₹2,206 cr, led by CDMO up about 86%; EBITDA ₹750 cr at a 34% margin (up 962 bps) and profit ₹437 cr. Still the cleanest earnings beat on the list; pharma rose 0.6% on 19 Nov.
buy_ideas.risks: Upside to target only about 9%. CDMO orders are lumpy. No fresh price found; ₹2,338 is the broker's reference price, so check the live quote. Prices move daily (Nifty -1.75% on 23 Nov, +1.85% on 25 Nov, +0.25% on 26 Nov), so check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: Hitachi Energy India
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue up 64% and profit up 21%; new orders up 86%, taking the order book to ₹33,300 cr. IDBI sees revenue up 57% in FY27 and margins rising to 16.7% by FY28; target about 25% above the reference price.
buy_ideas.risks: Price is implied from the 17 Nov note (no fresh quote found), so check it. Very expensive stock, and profit grew much slower than revenue. Prices move daily (Nifty -1.75% on 23 Nov, +1.85% on 25 Nov, +0.25% on 26 Nov), so check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: ABB India
buy_ideas.thesis: September-quarter revenue up 12% and profit up 8%, with a record order book up 36% to about ₹12,900 cr. Two brokers say Buy, targets about 18-20% above the price.
buy_ideas.risks: Margin fell 70 bps and profit growth was modest; valued at about 60 times 2028 earnings. No fresh price found; ₹6,923 is from the earlier broker notes. Prices move daily (Nifty -1.75% on 23 Nov, +1.85% on 25 Nov, +0.25% on 26 Nov), so check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: PTC Industries
buy_ideas.target_source: ICICI Securities (Buy, reiterated), via Trendlyne 24 Nov
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 72.7% and net profit 83.5% year on year, helped by aerospace contract wins from Safran and Airbus. ICICI Securities projects 70% revenue and 91% profit growth a year through FY29; its ₹29,000 target is 18.7% above the price.
buy_ideas.risks: Price is implied from the 18.7% upside (Trendlyne gave no quote), so check the live price. Very expensive, small-float stock that can swing hard; the growth depends on aerospace orders ramping up on time. Smallcaps lagged the 25 Nov rebound but rose 0.7% on 26 Nov.

avoid.reason: Down about 29% from its pre-deal close to Wednesday's low after agreeing to buy Tata Steel's tubes and colour-coated businesses for about ₹28,000 cr, debt-funded, with Tata Steel then taking control via a promoter stake buy and open offer (about ₹32,267 cr). Debt rises sharply; group stocks SG Finserve and SG Mart also crashed. Deal news, not earnings; let the price settle.

Bounced 2.5% on 26 Nov after falling about 10.5% in the previous two sessions on worries over the APL Apollo deal's valuation and debt funding (consolidated gross debt already ₹1.02 trn). A one-day bounce is not clarity; not an earnings move.

Management news, not earnings: the bank terminated former MD and CEO Sumant Kathpalia and will reclaim his pay since 2020; the stock bounced about 10% from the day's low on 20 Nov to above ₹1,000. Don't chase a news spike.
USFDA warning letter for its Daman plant, which brings in about 9% of revenue. US approvals from that site can stall; wait for the remediation plan.
Fell about 6% on 19 Nov after co-founder Alok Bansal said he is leaving his executive role, then jumped 7.6% to about ₹1,100 on 23 Nov. Management-news swings, not earnings; don't chase.

Results missed: Q2 revenue up only 4.1% and profit down 18.5% on raw-material costs; IDBI cut FY27-28 profit estimates by about 17%. IDBI still says Buy at ₹5,271 (30% upside, implying about ₹4,050) after a 21% fall in three months, but wait for margins to recover.

ICICI Direct says Sell with a ₹490 target (about 10% below ₹544) as margins shrank sharply despite strong revenue.
Results missed: Q2 loss of about ₹5,531 cr after one-off charges and JLR cut its margin guidance to 2-3%. Bounced 3.7% on 19 Nov with the auto rally, but that is a sector move, not a fix.
Results missed: Q2 profit fell about 62%. ICICI Direct says only Hold at ₹3,100 (about 8% above ₹2,858).

Results missed: Q2 profit fell 74% to ₹31 cr despite revenue up 21%.

Auditor could not sign off on consolidated results over unreconciled loans at Hinduja Leyland Finance. Brokers are split (Joindre Buy ₹192, BOB Hold ₹190, ICICI Direct Hold ₹170 vs ₹162) and margins fell 2 points. Wait for clarity.
